intent: procedures: add pre-gator-residue + committing-gator-files (v1→v2 upgrade guidance)
notes: Two new shipped procedures in `.gator/.includes/procedures/` for AI-model consumption. Both address recurring model-confusion pain surfaced by the Architect: agents in Gator-governed repos frequently get confused by `.pre.gator*` residue files (from `gator update --migrate-layout` v1→v2 upgrades) and by the general question "should I commit `.gator/` files that Gator itself changed?" Both procedures give unambiguous decision procedures so agents stop asking the operator for routine flow.

**`pre-gator-residue.md`** (~90 lines) — what `.pre.gator*` files ARE (rollback safety-net backups from `migrate_layout()`), what they are NOT (governance, docs, commit-worthy), and what to do with them: **move to `.gator/vault/pre-update-backups/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<original-path>/`**. Includes explicit non-actions, discovery-check `find` commands agents can run at session open, why-this-exists framing (4 common failure modes without the procedure), and cross-references to the two related surfaces.

**`committing-gator-files.md`** (~80 lines) — default rule: **most `.gator/` changes SHOULD be committed** when Gator produced them. Enumerated exceptions: (a) `.pre.gator*` backups → vault; (b) `.gator/vault/` → never; (c) post-commit residue (`commit_draft.md` + `whiteboard.md` → don't re-commit; cross-refs `expected-governance-residue.md`); (d) session snippets from unrelated sessions → let next commit's post-commit hook sweep naturally; (e) machine-local operational state → `.tmp/` or vault. Practical decision procedure as a 5-step ladder + 5 common failure modes without the procedure.

**Location decision — `.gator/.includes/procedures/`**: shipped-content path. Both files propagate to every governed repo on next `gator update`. Automatically hidden from the dashboard file browser because `.includes` is not in `VISIBLE_DIRS` at `dashboard/views/repo.js:218` — the v2 layout's built-in whitelist mechanism hides shipped content by default. No `DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_FILES` allowlist edit needed (that's the v1-layout safety net for cases where shipped defaults were copied down into `.gator/procedures/` directly).

**Constitution cross-reference** (`.gator/.includes/constitution.md` "The Loop" step 8 note on Expected governance residue): appended pointers to both new procedures so agents naturally discover them at the exact spot in the loop where the questions come up. Existing `expected-governance-residue.md` reference-note (covering only post-commit `commit_draft.md`/`whiteboard.md` rotation) is preserved and cross-referenced from `committing-gator-files.md` — no overlap, complementary coverage.

**`.pre.gator*` policy — vault (Architect ratified 2026-08-14)**: chosen over "leave in place" and "delete immediately". Rationale: (1) removes AI-model confusion (the reported pain); (2) preserves rollback safety for ~30d window; (3) aligns with vault's stated purpose ("Sensitive material and large files, gitignored, never committed"); (4) keeps the working tree clean of migration artifacts. Auto-vaulting inside `gator update` itself is a follow-on code change not scoped here — the procedure documents the manual/recommended behavior for now.

Companion vault artifact (not in this commit): [`.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-14-enterprise-audit-surface-implementation-plan.md`](vault/artifacts/2026-08-14-enterprise-audit-surface-implementation-plan.md) — converted the 2026-08-14 Codex next-steps sketch into a full 6-phase implementation plan mapping sketch Steps 1-6 to roadmap items 13 → 14 → 9 → 10 → 11 → 15. Vault-only, gitignored, machine-local.

Verification: no code touched; procedure + constitution edits only. Test suite unchanged (770 passed, 2 pre-existing xfails). No pre-commit hook charter-index-gap check triggers because none of these files are code paths mapped through INDEX.md.
